drawdown_policy.after_halt: continue accumulating hosting/tool/model expenses until services stop; report costs and incomplete/stopped status
drawdown_policy.nonprimary_halt: disable new entries in both arms of that wallet pair, close inventory using explicit paper risk-stop reason; no further strategy-learning trades from it
drawdown_policy.peak: running observed net liquidation equity peak since actual activation; fees/open inventory/all applicable accrued costs included
drawdown_policy.primary_halt: halt entries and steering across entire paired experiment, close all simulated inventory explicitly
drawdown_policy.reset: no automatic reset of equity peak, wallet capital or experiment identity
drawdown_policy.unknown_equity: block entries until measured; do not invent a peak

initial_migration: isolated new virtual accounts; no imported historic equity or positions
USDT to EUR with preserved available symbol thresholds
published conservative fees and taker-only baseline; passive fill quality unverified
fixed risk/order/exposure caps; no increases to fit exchange minimums
exit.max_bars changed from48to24at initialization to fit existing bounded LLM action menu; not an experimental improvement claim
launch_blockers: verified pinned model access and usage/cost provenance
explicit operating cost accrual assumptions and freshness producer
common-input paired runner and durable restart/publication boundary
minimum safety, daily backup and operational entry-halt enforcement
fresh market minimums and execution constraints
publication_activation: only snapshots with closed candle timestamps strictly after durable decision/publication effective_at; unfinished batches retain original strategies

qualification.estimator: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of aligned daily log-equity changes, 7-day blocks, 10000resamples with prespecified seed and sensitivity to14-dayblocks
qualification.incomplete_data: no imputation or zero-cost substitution; no qualification when required windows are incomplete
qualification.partial_close_independence: group partial legs and remainder under original entry lineage; do not count them as independent trades
qualification.primary_comparison: EUR200 adaptive standalone full-cost net growth; paired adaptive-minus-control improvement reported separately
qualification.secondary_wallets: exploratory until multiplicity-adjusted qualification; no independent-replication claim
qualification.stress: prespecified2xtradingfees/slippageand2xoperatingcostscenario, preserving causal original orders/strategyepochs; feasibility and insolvency reported

stop_rules: unknown/stale wallet cost or mark: block entries, maintain protective exits
recovery trade: halt learning until reconciliation
incomplete paired batch: replay original common inputs before new collection

storage_decision.launch_policy: MVP whole-volume70percent entry alert; bounded diagnostic rotation; daily consistent state copy
